_comment: Fingerprints for default error pages (404 / 500) that disclose server software, language, or framework. Each entry has body_patterns (regexes; ANY match triggers detection) and an optional version_pattern (regex with named group 'version' that, if it matches, produces an 'origin_with_version' outcome instead of 'origin_no_version'). Triggering = a finding; matching version_pattern = stronger finding. Patterns are deliberately tied to the *layout* of default error pages (specific tags, address blocks, error-report titles) rather than just keyword matches, to keep false positives low.

fingerprints.name: Apache
fingerprints._comment: Apache default error pages always include an <address>Apache...</address> block (or 'Apache Server at' line in older versions). The title alone is too generic to fingerprint on — many frameworks use the same '404 Not Found' text.

fingerprints.name: nginx
fingerprints._comment: nginx default error pages have a distinctive structure: <h1> inside <center>, then <hr><center>nginx</center>. We require the centered nginx attribution rather than just the title — the title alone is too generic (Flask's default 404, custom pages, and many frameworks start the same way).

fingerprints.name: PHP
fingerprints._comment: PHP error disclosures: Warning/Fatal/Notice/Parse/Deprecated with file paths. Specific to default display_errors=On configuration. We require both the level keyword AND a path-like fragment to keep FPs low — a plain 'Warning:' string in body text doesn't match.

fingerprints.name: Django
fingerprints._comment: Django DEBUG=True traceback page is a major disclosure. Distinct fingerprint: the orange/red header bar and traceback layout. We match the structural elements rather than colors.
body_patterns: You're seeing this error because you have DEBUG = True

fingerprints.name: Flask
fingerprints._comment: Flask's default 404 is minimal but distinct. Werkzeug debugger page (DEBUG=True) is a much worse disclosure.
body_patterns:
\s*

\s*Not\s+Found\s*

\s*

The requested URL was not found on the server\.
